known_limits: Exact B1 Zoi bindings in older SceneZOI releases could suppress independent wildcard callbacks. SceneZOI 1.1.5 uses appearance components and passed B1/B2 receiver checks. Organized Crime mission compatibility has not been verified.
Fixed membership per session; predetermined watch-only sequences are deferred.
The manual picker accepts two or three Zois; bundled hubs require adult-compatible male/female appearance roles. Other rosters require compatible authored content.
Script-made speech bubbles and thought icons are withheld for participants; icons the game sends without a script command are not. Marker suppression is participant-scoped.
New facial poses, customized heads, meshes and furniture require their own fit tests. The female O was visually accepted; no new tongue asset was created or visually tested.
Furniture profiles support upright unit-scale objects with fixed placement offsets; all cosmetic variants, occupancy/menu routes and third-party combinations were not exhaustively tested.
Native mod-manager dependency enforcement/load ordering is not established by manifest declarations. SceneZOI must remain enabled for save-journal recovery.

World teardown may prevent a final event. An earlier interrupted-session record lacked a complete final acknowledgement trace; subsequent idle state, participant settings and bed release were read back separately.

compatibility_release_1_2_1.release_change: Cancelling a debug picker or failing an add-on start also discards the corresponding native commands queued before receiver attachment. The original AFA in-game acceptance used receiver build 2.
compatibility_release_1_2_1.automated_checks: Catalog build and full framework suite passed. Regression verifies a late receiver cannot deliver cancelled commands and preserves an unrelated queued command.
compatibility_release_1_2_1.native_validation: ModKit Lua and both UI apps passed. Isolated PackageUGC and exact four-asset filtering passed. Prepared Lua matched source, the protected export changed only the four expected Lua files, and catalog rows matched the existing native patch.
compatibility_release_1_2_1.verification_limits: The cancellation change was verified with an automated regression. A separate in-game test of the exact 1.2.1 ZIP with cleared preferences was not run.

simulation_receiver_recovery.reproduction: A fresh game launch with AFA 0.6.0 reached Solo Idle selection, then timed out preparing and restoring the participant. A scoped AFA remount reproduced it. A temporary dynamic Lua module received the actual Prepare and Release messages on the same Zoi and restored a clean Start and Exit.
simulation_receiver_recovery.change: The simulation attaches a native receiver to the controlled Zoi. Native request and acknowledgement messages attach the same receiver to additional targets before releasing pending commands. The client uses per-actor tickets and retries attachment while the target loads.
simulation_receiver_recovery.automated_checks: Framework suite passed. Regression covers missing and replacement actors, stale acknowledgement, ordered first delivery and the native receiver's save, load and end callbacks.
simulation_receiver_recovery.native_validation: ModKit Lua reported zero errors and two existing AddonAPI shadowing warnings. Both UI apps passed. Isolated PackageUGC and exact four-asset filtering passed. Installed Lua and native integrity entries were verified with cooked payload hashes preserved.
simulation_receiver_recovery.retail_readback: With temporary probes removed and AFA 0.6.0 enabled, Solo Idle entered playback and ended with ok/ok before and after a scoped AFA Live remount. The remount changed the client Lua host while the controls and launcher stayed mounted. Autosave was released and the recovery journal was empty after both exits.
simulation_receiver_recovery.fresh_process_retest: The author relaunched and used the native Solo SceneZOI entry. The first attempt was interrupted by AFA's startup remount with mod_unloaded before playback. Two subsequent starts in the same fresh process reached Solo Idle playback and exited cleanly. Final Exit was ok/ok, input was restored, autosave was released and the journal was empty.
simulation_receiver_recovery.afa_0_7_0_author_acceptance: The maintainer reported that SceneZOI worked with AFA 0.7.0 and that AFA appeared to block inputs during its Lua relaunch.
simulation_receiver_recovery.verification_limits: AFA 0.6.0 can still interrupt a scene already preparing when it remounts Lua. The independent API-start reports remain unverified.

launcher_handshake_recovery.automated_checks: Catalog build and full framework suite passed. Regressions cover an existing launcher pairing surviving a Lua restart, mismatched UI instances and stale Start requests.
launcher_handshake_recovery.native_validation: ModKit Lua and both UI apps passed. Isolated PackageUGC succeeded and the exact filter retained four owned asset packages. Two protected Lua files and three UI files were hot-installed and verified using native integrity records, preserving loaded cooked bytes and preferences.
launcher_handshake_recovery.retail_launcher: A scoped AFA Live 0.6.0 remount changed the B1 host. The existing controls acknowledged the new host with the original launcher pairing. The author clicked the native solo row and the runtime selected the controlled Zoi and Solo Idle.
launcher_handshake_recovery.retail_participant_timeout: Playback did not begin after the AFA remount. The runtime recorded prepare_timeout followed by restore_timeout. Autosave was released and the journal was empty. A full Lua reload restored playback and Exit. A second AFA remount reproduced the failure. Reloading B2 alone restored the same solo scene to playing/ok and Exit to ok/ok without a new B1 host or UI remount. The recovery cycles used the normal solo selection and Exit mailboxes.
launcher_handshake_recovery.verification_limits: The simulation dispatch failure after the scoped remount remains open. Fresh-process acceptance, AFA 0.7.0 and reported API-start failures remain unverified.

solo_launcher_and_debug_start.automated_checks: Framework suite passed. Coverage includes direct compatible solo entry with no picker, control and ownership refusal, both debug switch states, any supported furniture profile, pooled row restoration and restart with stale focus and Start records.
solo_launcher_and_debug_start.native_validation: ModKit Lua and both UI apps passed without errors. The filtered local exports retained exactly the four owned cooked assets. The hot updates preserved the loaded cooked bytes and used native integrity values.
solo_launcher_and_debug_start.retail_readback: The solo row appeared immediately below AI Emote without MOD and started neutral solo playback with no picker or plan. After a fresh launch the styled switch saved on, the debug picker started a paired standing scene, and switching off allowed direct solo entry again. The paired standing Exit completed ok/ok. A subsequent debug start on a supported bed reached paired playback.
solo_launcher_and_debug_start.crash_and_recovery: One retail process reported an out-of-memory allocation of about 109 GiB during a solo preparation after a UI remount, before switch interaction. Cause unconfirmed. The fresh process restored autosave but initially reopened the old panel from a stale focus record while the session registry was idle. Resetting the focus record hid the panel. The runtime now publishes its empty focus on boot.
solo_launcher_and_debug_start.verification_limits: Furniture support beyond the tested bed was exercised with an automated non-bed profile. The allocation failure did not recur during the subsequent tested starts.

session_recovery_and_manual_timeout.automated_checks: Framework suite passed. Returning to a manual scene resets its 60-second off-panel timer. Expiry releases its roster and leaves other sessions playing. A 40-record journal survives loading, a failed publication, adding a 41st record and reloading. Participant and furniture acknowledgements retire the older record independently.
session_recovery_and_manual_timeout.native_validation: ModKit Lua and both UI apps passed without errors. Prepared bytes matched source. Isolated PackageUGC succeeded and the exact filter retained four owned asset packages.
session_recovery_and_manual_timeout.installation: Three protected Lua files and their native checksums hot-installed and hash-verified. Cooked containers and persisted preferences matched the backup. Launcher and controls acknowledged the new runtime after remount.
session_recovery_and_manual_timeout.retail_readback: Author clicked Start Solo and switched to another household Zoi during playback. Focus cleared and autosave was released while the journal still held the active record. About 60.1 seconds after the observed focus switch, the scene was idle with lifetime_expired and the journal was empty.
session_recovery_and_manual_timeout.verification_limits: Journal retention beyond 32 records was exercised with automated fixtures. No large journal was injected into a retail save, and packaged save/load was not repeated for this update.

task_overlay_and_hand_props.baseline: Retail 1.2.2 left the reading participant's protected grab loop and carried book active after cancellation. The sofa phone task left an interruptible posture montage and an attached static mesh actor. The carried book and phone had no simulation AttachMesh entries.
task_overlay_and_hand_props.automated_checks: Full framework suite passed. Regressions cover group-based overlay filtering, protected and posture motions, grip identity, legacy and new recovery data, unrelated attachments, and independent prop restoration.
task_overlay_and_hand_props.native_validation: ModKit Lua validated. Isolated native package build and exact four-asset filter passed. Three protected Lua files were hash-verified locally with existing cooked containers preserved.
task_overlay_and_hand_props.retail_readback: In separate standing sessions, native reading and grip motions were absent during playback, the chair posture remained, and the original book was hidden. The original grip, carried entity and visibility returned after Exit. The sofa posture remained and its phone was hidden during playback, then visible at the original posture after Exit. Both sessions exited ok/ok. After diagnostic removal, launcher readiness matched and the save journal was empty.
task_overlay_and_hand_props.author_acceptance: The maintainer restarted the game with the installed runtime changes and approved the candidate for release.
task_overlay_and_hand_props.verification_limits: The game still owns the original posture and carried items after Exit. Grip recovery was exercised with an automated save record. The new candidate has not had a live save/load run.

instant_overlay_stop_probe.observation: The native motion.stop command exposes an animation ID and uses the game's stop behavior. In the presentation animation instance, the current montage can be the chair idle while the exact reading montage is still playing in UpperBodySlot.
instant_overlay_stop_probe.retail_readback: On the same authored frame of the active reading montage, the zero-duration stop moved the wrist to within about 1.2 cm of its settled position at 22 ms and 0.12 cm at 44 ms. The 0.25-second control was still 7.6 cm away at 44 ms. The chair montage remained active. Active-state readbacks alone could not distinguish the two stops.
instant_overlay_stop_probe.scene_entry_readback: The installed update reported one zero-blend cut for the reading participant. The actual client montage stayed inactive across the first 24 standing scene render samples. Native chair posture remained, the simulation settled, and Exit completed ok/ok.
instant_overlay_stop_probe.candidate_checks: Framework tests and ModKit Lua validation passed. The isolated package retained only the four owned assets. Protected Lua was hash-verified after installation, preserving loaded cooked bytes.
instant_overlay_stop_probe.residual_pose_blend: The maintainer observed visible drift despite the montage cut. On a frozen scene pose, the pelvis reached its final position on the first evaluation while the wrists remained about 44 and 54 cm off. Repeated A/B tests showed a 450 ms readiness wait removed left-wrist drift and left about 2 cm on the right.
instant_overlay_stop_probe.pose_settle_candidate: Initial entries with an interrupted overlay or residual grip give native teardown 650 ms before the scene snap. The installed candidate matched both wrists to their settled positions on the first evaluated frame and the next six samples, to the 0.01 cm readback precision. Post-processing stayed active and Exit completed ok/ok. Framework checks and ModKit Lua validation passed, and the protected Lua hot update preserved cooked assets.
instant_overlay_stop_probe.rollback: The 650 ms buffer was reverted at the maintainer's request. The current implementation keeps the targeted zero-blend montage cut and uses the previous preparation timing.
instant_overlay_stop_probe.verification_limits: The separate native pose blend can still be visible after the targeted montage cut. The buffer measurements are historical.

entry_exit_hitch_fix.baseline: Two native standing cycles measured autosave acquisition at 286-288 ms and restoration at 282-295 ms. Entry re-enumerated the native Text table in 34-35 ms. Largest observed frame samples were 359-360 ms on entry and 313-324 ms on Exit.
entry_exit_hitch_fix.candidate: Native reflected autosave flag writes and SaveSettings preserve the lease and avoid the full settings reapply. Idle discovery continues and entry uses the published catalog. In two repeated standing tests, measured autosave calls were under 5 ms and no recorded frame reached the 45 ms diagnostic threshold.
entry_exit_hitch_fix.autosave: The live game setting and settings file agreed before entry, while disabled in playback and after Exit. The 15-minute interval stayed unchanged. The acknowledged save journal contained both participants during playback, and the final journal was empty.
entry_exit_hitch_fix.overlap: A short background solo session started and ended beside the focused standing scene. The focused session kept playing and retained its autosave lease. No sampled frame reached 45 ms, and final Exit was ok/ok.
entry_exit_hitch_fix.checks: Full framework suite and ModKit Lua validation passed. Isolated packaging retained the four owned asset packages. Three protected Lua files and native integrity entries were hash-verified locally with cooked bytes preserved.
entry_exit_hitch_fix.limits: The tests exercised warm standing transitions and one overlapping background session. They did not force the scheduled autosave timer to expire or cover all content and asset streaming combinations.

preparation_and_autonomy.automated: Task tests cover early Exit, queue clearing before the overlay acknowledgement, and autonomy rechecks during preparation and playback.
preparation_and_autonomy.modkit: Lua validation passed with zero errors and the two existing AddonAPI shadowing warnings.
preparation_and_autonomy.live_candidate: A retail readback found one participant's effective autonomy on during playback. Repeated attempts through the old command left autonomy unstable and preparation timed out. Direct native character-option writes resolved the timeout. Both participants stayed disabled during standing playback, an injected mid-scene enable was corrected, and Exit restored both enabled settings and their inheritance flags.
preparation_and_autonomy.early_exit: A normal standing scene in the candidate reached playback and exited cleanly. The following immediate cancellation crashed on the simulation thread before the cleanup acknowledgement. The revised candidate skips native restoration for position, collision and autonomy when the live lease never changed them, while retaining full journaled recovery.
preparation_and_autonomy.installation: The framework tests and ModKit Lua validation passed on the revised candidate. An isolated owned-payload build was filtered and its changed Lua bytes and integrity entry were verified in the local installation.
preparation_and_autonomy.limits: After a fresh retail launch, a normal standing start/Exit and a second start canceled during preparation both ended with clean cleanup and an empty journal. The maintainer observed that WASD could still move the controlled Zoi during preparation. The experimental locks were removed.
